seoTitle: One Tree Hill Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the One Tree Hill test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Lucas, Nathan, Peyton, Brooke, Haley, Dan, Mouth or Whitey — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the brooding writer, the reformed rival, or the girl who built an empire? Answer 12 everyday questions about friendship, family and chasing your dreams, and find out which One Tree Hill character you are.

characters.name: Lucas Scott
characters.title: The Brooding Writer
characters.summary: Thoughtful, loyal and always thinking a little too deeply. You'd rather understand people than judge them.
description: Like Lucas, you've got an old soul. He's Haley's best friend and Nathan's half-brother, and he grew up shooting hoops at the River Court.
You turn life into stories. After a heart condition ended his basketball career, Lucas turned to writing novels.
You're loyal to the end. Lucas sticks by his friends, even when love triangles make things complicated.
characters.flaw: You overthink everything until the moment has passed.
characters.signature: A well-worn novel, a basketball and the River Court at sunset.
characters.clashReason: they'd brood for days instead of just telling you

characters.name: Nathan Scott
characters.title: The Reformed Rival
characters.summary: Driven, competitive and fiercely protective. You started out as the bad boy and became the one everyone counts on.
description: Like Nathan, you hate to lose. He's a talented basketball player who started out as Lucas's rival.
You grow up fast. Nathan goes from cocky jock to devoted brother, husband and dad.
You never stop chasing the dream. Nathan's NBA hopes take some brutal hits, but he keeps fighting, and he protects his family above everything.
characters.flaw: Your pride gets you into trouble before your heart can catch up.
characters.signature: A basketball, a wedding ring and something to prove.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every game night into a war

characters.name: Peyton Sawyer
characters.title: The Guarded Artist
characters.summary: Creative, independent and slow to trust. You feel everything, and you put it all into your art.
description: Like Peyton, you live for music and art. She's always drawing, and her taste in music is legendary.
You protect your heart. Peyton is independent and emotionally guarded, and it takes a lot for her to let anyone in.
You turn your passion into something real. Peyton goes on to start her own record label.
characters.flaw: You push people away before they get the chance to leave.
characters.signature: A sketchbook, a stack of records and a song that says what you can't.
characters.clashReason: they'd shut you out the moment things got real

characters.name: Brooke Davis
characters.title: The Boss
characters.summary: Fun, fearless and far more determined than anyone expects. You can throw a party, or build an empire.
description: Like Brooke, you know how to have fun. She starts out as Tree Hill's party girl, always at the centre of everything.
But you're more than people think. Brooke built her fashion line, Clothes Over Bros, into a major company.
You're loyal to your people. Underneath all the confidence, Brooke is a fiercely loyal friend.
characters.flaw: You act like nothing hurts, even when everything does.
characters.signature: A killer outfit, a sketch of your next design and a smile that hides everything.
characters.clashReason: they'd throw you a party when you really just wanted to talk

characters.name: Haley James Scott
characters.title: The Heart of the Group
characters.summary: Smart, caring and steady. You keep everyone grounded, and you're braver than you let on.
description: Like Haley, you're the dependable one. She started out tutoring Nathan, and it turned into one of the show's great love stories.
You've got a hidden talent. Haley is a gifted singer, and she chases that dream too.
You hold everyone together. Haley is a supportive, caring presence for her family and friends.
characters.flaw: You look after everyone else so well that you forget about yourself.
characters.signature: A song in your head, a pile of homework you're helping with and a ring on your finger.
characters.clashReason: they'd always be right, and kindly tell you so

characters.name: Dan Scott
characters.title: The Villain
characters.summary: Ruthless, controlling and determined to win at any cost. You hold grudges, and you rarely say sorry.
description: Like Dan, you play to win. He's Lucas and Nathan's father, and the show's original villain.
You use people. Dan manipulates and takes revenge on anyone who crosses him, and he even shot his own brother, Keith.
But even you have regrets. Over time, Dan tries to make amends, and he finally shows real remorse for what he's done.
characters.flaw: You'd sacrifice anyone, even family, to come out on top.
characters.signature: A cold smile, a long memory and a long list of enemies.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn your own family against you

characters.name: Mouth McFadden
characters.title: The Loyal Friend
characters.summary: Kind, nerdy and endlessly loyal. You're the friend everyone needs, and you never ask for anything back.
description: Like Mouth, you're there for your friends. He's part of the River Court crew, and he's never been the cool kid.
You've always got something to say. Mouth goes on to work in the media, including on air.
You're a nice guy, and proud of it. Mouth's loyalty and big heart make him one of the most loved people in Tree Hill.
characters.flaw: You're so nice that people walk all over you.
characters.signature: A headset, a scoresheet and a running commentary on everything.

characters.name: Whitey Durham
characters.title: The Wise Old Coach
characters.summary: Gruff, honest and wiser than anyone. You give tough love, and you mean every word.
description: Like Whitey, you're the voice of experience. He's the coach of the Tree Hill Ravens basketball team.
You tell it like it is. Whitey's advice can be hard to hear, but half of Tree Hill has learned something from him.
You believe people can change. Even after years of bad blood, Whitey eventually makes peace with Dan.
characters.flaw: You're so set in your ways that you'd rather be right than adapt.
characters.signature: A whistle, a clipboard and a speech that changes someone's life.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you hard truths you didn't ask for

questions.text: You join a pick-up basketball game in the park. You...

options.text: Play like it's a championship final. You don't do casual
Sit it out and keep everyone's stats instead
Coach everyone from the sidelines, whether they asked or not
Play for fun, then stay out after dark shooting hoops on your own

questions.text: Your best friend falls for someone you secretly like. You...

options.text: Say nothing, and write about it instead
Feel betrayed, then fight for the friendship anyway
Pull away, and put on a very sad record
Be happy for them. Friendship comes first

questions.text: A friend you'd have done anything for lets you down badly. You...

options.text: Never forgive them, and make sure they regret it
Decide this is exactly why you don't let people in
Give them a chance to explain. People make mistakes
Tell them bluntly what they did, then let them earn it back

questions.text: You're throwing a big party at your place. You...

options.text: Go all out. Theme, guest list, the works
Take charge of the music. Nobody touches the playlist
Make sure nobody's left standing on their own
Invite the people who can do something for you

questions.text: You get a shot at your dream, but it means leaving home. You...

options.text: Go. You've worked your whole life for this
Go for it, then realise home matters more
Stay. Everything you want to write about is right here
Take it, but call home every single night

questions.text: You make a big mistake at work. You...

options.text: Make sure someone else takes the blame
Fix it overnight. Nobody needs to know
Own up straight away. Honesty's the only way
Get angry with yourself, then work twice as hard

questions.text: Someone younger asks you for advice. You...

options.text: Give it to them straight. They'll thank you in twenty years
Sit with them and help them work it out, step by step
Hand them a book that changed your life
Tell them winning is the only thing that matters

questions.text: You're having a terrible week. You...

options.text: Shut yourself away and stop answering anyone's calls
Put on your best outfit and fake it till you make it
Go for a long, quiet walk and think about everything
Shoot hoops until you can't feel your arms

questions.text: Your family is falling apart. You...

options.text: Hold everyone together, whatever it takes
Make it all about how much they've let you down
Step up. You're not going to end up like your dad
Show up for everyone, quietly, day after day

questions.text: Someone you hurt badly gives you a second chance. You...

options.text: Promise to change, and mean it this time. Probably
Prove you deserve it, every single day
Never take it for granted again
Struggle to believe they really mean it

questions.text: You coach a high school basketball team, and your two best players are brothers who can't stand each other. You...

options.text: Make them run laps together until they learn to be a team
Play favourites. Only one of them really matters to you
Lock them in the gym together until they've talked it out
Tell them to settle it one-on-one, on the court

questions.text: Your whole town lives for high school basketball, and tonight's the big game. You...

options.text: Give the locker-room speech of your life
Play your heart out. This might be your last big game
Lead the cheer squad. The crowd is yours
Sit in the stands, sketching the crowd
